stories.headline: Four killed, including three children, in Oregon primary school shooting

sources.body:
A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.

The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.

The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.

The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11. A seven-year-old and a 54-year-old teacher were taken to a hospital in a critical condition, Krantz said. It is unclear if the attacker had any links to the school.

"We are stunned and heartbroken by this senseless tragedy," Steven Cook, the top administrative official of the local school district, said in a statement.

"No words can adequately express the grief our community is experiencing."

Police said the attacker was a local 16-year-old boy, but they did not release any further details on him or the identity of the victims.

Police were alerted to an active shooter at Silver Rail Elementary at 12:59 local time, Bend Police Department spokeswoman Sheila Miller told reporters.

The first call came from a person who said that an unknown suspect was shooting into their car with a long gun, police said. Photos released from the scene show a red truck with bullet holes.

Minutes later, the local county dispatch received 911 calls reporting that the attacker had entered the school.

Police said he shot at locks on the doors in order to force his way inside.

Local media reports suggested the school received new classroom doors in 2022 which can be locked with the flip of a switch.

A bystander saw the shooting begin to unfold, pursued the attacker into the school and shot him dead, police said.

Three minutes later, officers first arrived at the scene. They confirmed that the attacker had been killed, and then searched the school.

Schools in Bend have been closed on Friday. Officials said the community needed time to heal.

Around 450 children attend Silver Rail Elementary School, which has more than 40 adult staff members, police said.

According to the K-12 School Shooting Database, there were 235 shooting incidents at American schools last year and at least 140 so far this year.
sources.headline: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting

sources.body:
The police chief in Bend, Oregon, identified the shooter as a 16-year-old who was killed by a bystander at the school.

At least four people have been killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Oregon, part of the northwestern United States, according to local law enforcement.

The shooting on Thursday took place at Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend, about 160 kilometres (100 miles) southeast of Portland.

Three children were among the dead: they were aged five, eight and 11, according to Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz. A teacher was also killed.

In addition, a seven-year-old child and a 54-year-old teacher were transported to St Charles Medical Center in Bend with critical injuries.

In an afternoon news conference, Krantz identified the alleged shooter as a 16-year-old Bend resident, who was killed at the scene. The suspect has yet to be named.

“What the initial investigation is showing is that the shooter had forced their way into the school by shooting at locked doors,” Krantz said. He added that investigators were still determining whether the suspect had attended the school at any point.

Emergency services began receiving calls for help around 12:59pm local time (19:59 GMT), with “dozens” of additional calls in the ensuing minutes.

The first call, Krantz explained, came from “a person in a vehicle who reported being shot at multiple times by a person with a long gun”. The elementary school went into lockdown at 1:01pm (20:01 GMT), and officers arrived on the scene shortly thereafter.

“Moments later, an officer reported that a suspect had been shot by a community member who had seen the suspect enter the school and pursued him into the school and engaged him,” Krantz said.

“Our officers entered the building and confirmed the suspect was dead. They cleared the school to ensure there were no additional threats and then rendered emergency aid to the victims.”

He emphasised that the police investigation was ongoing and further information would be released to the public in the coming days.

The families of the victims have been notified of the attack. Police evacuated each room in the school, and students and staff were transported by bus to a nearby church where they could be reunited with their loved ones.

“This is the kind of thing we never want to see happen in Bend. It’s devastating,” said Sheila Miller, the communications manager for the Bend Police Department, on Thursday.

Kash Patel, the director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), said in a post on social media that the agency was on the scene assisting local law enforcement in the investigation.

“We will make every resource they need available,” he wrote.

Oregon Governor Tina Kotek called on Oregonians to come together to support each other through their grief.

“All Oregonians mourn this loss today. This is a horrible day. No parent should have to have this kind of day, and no community should have to live through this kind of day,” Kotek said.

She also addressed the unnamed bystander who confronted the shooter. “To the community member who heroically intervened to stop further loss of life, your actions carry a heavy emotional burden, and I just want you to know that my thoughts are with you as well.”
sources.headline: Three children, one teacher killed in Oregon school shooting

stories.headline: Ukraine resumes refinery strikes as Trump-backed energy ceasefire collapses

sources.body:
Moscow sends swarms of drones to attack infrastructure in central Ukraine as Zelenskyy says Kyiv will restart strikes on Russian oil refineries

The White House’s unilateral effort to negotiate an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine has collapsed as Moscow sent a record swarm of drones overnight to attack infrastructure in central Ukraine and Kyiv appeared to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries despite warnings from Donald Trump.

Moscow accused Ukraine of launching a strike against a Russian oil refinery in the Ryazan region, its first since Trump abruptly declared an “energy ceasefire” that neither Russia nor Ukraine said they had agreed to.

Trump has demanded that Volodymyr Zelenskyy stop attacking Russian oil refineries, claiming it is the cause of a global rise in the price of diesel fuel.

An attack on two neutral ships in Romanian territorial waters at the mouth of the Danube River indicated that strikes against vulnerable commercial targets are set to expand.

The Romanian president, Nicușor Dan, said two Russian drones violated Romanian airspace and struck two chemical tankers, setting the ships ablaze. Rescue crews were searching for at least seven missing sailors.

“The situation in the Black Sea is serious,” he said. “Commercial ships are being attacked and sunk. Seafarers killed, injured and missing, very close to the shores of Romania and Bulgaria. This is unacceptable and it has to stop.”

Zelenskyy said on Wednesday he would resume strikes on Russian oil refineries, after briefly halting them to demonstrate that Ukraine was ready for peace talks. “The block [on attacking refineries] is out. We’re done,” he told the Financial Times. He also attacked a gap in US intelligence sharing as “dangerous”.

Images from Ryazan showed flames at the refinery, which regional officials said had been targeted by 69 drones and four Flamingo cruise missiles. Moscow claimed debris from a drone struck by anti-aircraft fire had hit the refinery and sparked the fire.

Ukraine also struck back at Russia’s military, hitting four Sukhoi Su-34 fighter/bomber jets and damaging two more, according to Zelenskyy. Ukraine’s military said it had used a Neptune cruise missile to strike an airfield in Russia’s southern Voronezh region.

“These very warplanes were ready to launch new attacks on Ukraine and were loaded with aerial bombs,” Zelenskyy said, publishing a satellite photo of the damaged airfield.

In Ukraine, more than 360 Russian drones targeted Kirovohrad, a central region that has been hit less hard than others closer to Russia, in attacks that killed three people and injured six.

“The enemy deliberately hit critical infrastructure, transport enterprises, logistics ⁠facilities and residential homes,” the regional governor, Andriy Raikovych, said in a statement.

Zelenskyy said Russia had attacked Ukraine with more than 850 Shahed drones at a time when the speed of Ukraine’s defensive capabilities was being “artificially restricted”, a reference to sudden limitations on Ukraine’s use of the Starlink and Starshield mobile internet terminals.
sources.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade strikes as Trump ‘energy ceasefire’ collapses

sources.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sought European backing Thursday after vowing to resume strikes on Russian oil refineries despite US President Donald Trump’s demands, as tensions with Washington escalated over sanctions, energy infrastructure attacks and restrictions on satellite communications.
sources.headline: Zelensky rallies European allies as US support for Ukraine wanes

sources.body:
Russia has accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery on Thursday after President Volodymyr Zelensky said such strikes, halted at the request of the US, would resume.

Zelensky said he had restricted attacks for three days while Russia continued striking Ukraine's energy infrastructure. "We're done," he told the Financial Times .

Russian President Vladimir Putin said Kyiv had also tried to hit refineries on Wednesday - which Ukraine denied - but there had been no "significant damage".

Zelensky also accused the US of withdrawing intelligence-sharing to pressure Kyiv into ending attacks but Ukrainian defence sources later told the BBC some functionality on Starlink satellite services had resumed.

They said "operation while on the move", part of Starlink's military service Starshield, had been restored, although it remains unclear whether restrictions on the speed at which drones could fly while still maintaining Starlink internet connection have been fully lifted.

Officials were still working to clarify "the reasons and circumstances" behind the move, the sources added.

In a separate development, seven people are missing after a drone attack set a chemical tanker on fire off Romania , according to naval officials. Moscow said it had hit two cargo ships with military cargo heading to Ukraine's Odesa port, without naming them.

The Kremlin said Kyiv had "attempted a large-scale attack" on a refinery south of Moscow early on Thursday.

According to Russia's defence ministry, four missiles and dozens of drones were intercepted and the falling debris caused a fire at the site in Ryazan.

Zelensky said dozens of Ukrainian cities had come under Russian attack in the past day.

He previously said he would agree to the "energy ceasefire" announced by US President Donald Trump on Sunday if Moscow also abided by it.

But he accused Russia of ignoring the proposed deal within hours of it being announced, with strikes leaving hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians without power. The Kremlin never said it had agreed to the deal.

Zelensky agreed that he felt betrayed by the US when asked by Piers Morgan on Wednesday night, after Washington appeared to withdraw key elements of its support.

European leaders have rallied around the Ukrainian president. Italy's Defence Minister Guido Crosetto told the BBC that the US restricting its intelligence-sharing with Kyiv would be a "complete mistake".

"Because it is a fundamental form of support. This means denying a country any chance of defending itself."

He added: "Peace will be achieved when Putin will be convinced that there is a stalemate... that he cannot advance anymore. But if he sees a weakness on the Ukrainian front, if the United States takes its resources away, then Putin will think he can win, and so he will continue the war."

Zelensky met Nato chief Mark Rutte as a two-day summit of European leaders began in Brussels on Thursday. The head of the military alliance said they had discussed "the importance of implementing an energy ceasefire as well as Nato allies' continuous support for Ukraine".
sources.headline: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume

stories.headline: Houthi missile and drone attack on Yemen government palace kills five

sources.body: At least five people were killed and 16 wounded Thursday in a Houthi missile and drone attack on the palace located in Yemen's interim capital – the southern port city of Aden, used by the country's internationally recognised government, an official said.
sources.headline: Houthi attack on palace used by Yemen government in Aden kills five

sources.body:
Attack was the first on Aden’s Al-Maashiq palace ⁠in the latest fighting between ​the Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi Arabia

Yemen’s Houthis fired missiles at the presidential palace complex in the southern city of Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said, as the Saudi-led coalition listed dozens of Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure in ⁠recent weeks.

The attack was the first on Aden’s Al-Maashiq palace ⁠in the current conflict between ​the Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi Arabia . The palace is the seat of Yemen’s Saudi-backed and internationally recognised government.

Yemen’s prime minister, Shaya al-Zindani, ⁠and cabinet members were safe following the attack, Yemeni information minister Moammar al-Eryani said. Witnesses told Reuters they heard loud booms near the palace. Yemen’s cabinet said the attack involved missiles and drones.

Yemen’s health minister, Qasim Buhaibeh, said five people were killed and 16 wounded in the attack, with casualties including guards and civilian employees.

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said its fighters had bombed what he described as ​the Saudi military operations headquarters in Aden, as part of the group’s declared policy ‌of targeting “Saudi reinforcements wherever they were located”.

Agence France-Presse reported that a Yemeni government minister said on condition of anonymity that the palace attack had hit a command centre for the Saudi-led coalition. The official added that the command centre was hit by three missiles, and the headquarters of the coalition forces at the presidential complex with two missiles, adding that there were Yemeni and Saudi casualties, without providing a specific toll.

Fighting has escalated between the Houthi rebels and a Saudi-led coalition as part of clashes linked to the US and Israeli war on Iran , and aid agencies have warned of rapidly worsening conditions in Yemen.

The clashes have complicated efforts to end the wider Iran war and further rattled global markets as Saudi Arabia, one of the world’s top oil exporters, faces repeated attacks. Regional aviation is affected, too, as the rebels have warned airlines about their use of Saudi airspace for attacks. Thousands of flights across the kingdom have been disrupted.

The UN security council issued a joint statement on Thursday condemning the “escalatory” attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi Arabia, including “reckless strikes” on Riyadh’s airport.

The Saudi capital’s international airport has been targeted by strikes 20 times since the beginning of the month, with an attack last weekend killing 13 people and wounding more than 300.

In a joint statement shared by the security council “condemned in the strongest terms continued and escalatory Houthi attacks against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia,” as well as “continued Houthi attacks and threats against commercial shipping in the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab [strait]”.

Earlier on Thursday, the Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis said it intercepted a cruise missile over the province of Medina. Flightradar24, a tracking platform, said dozens of flights were canceled or delayed at Jeddah’s airport.
sources.headline: Houthi missiles strike Yemen presidential palace, killing five

stories.headline: Israel halts commercial goods entering Gaza, as hospitals report severe pressure

sources.body:
The halt to commercial shipments, including fruit and winter clothing, cuts off a key source of critical supplies.

Israeli authorities say no commercial goods have entered Gaza for two days, citing what they claim is a tax dispute between local merchants and Hamas.

COGAT, or the Coordinator of Government Activities in the Territories, the Israeli military body that “oversees humanitarian affairs” in Gaza, announced the halt on Wednesday.

COGAT claimed that local merchants “made the decision in response to a 10,000 shekel ($3,220) fee imposed by Hamas on each truck entering Gaza” as well as a demand for 30 percent of all sales in Gaza to be carried out in cash.

This decision is expected to impact a crucial source of food and goods for the 2.1 million people in the Strip, who are completely reliant on Israel’s border crossings in a territory that is still suffering from famine .

Gaza’s government media office refuted the claims on Thursday and condemned the “blatant disinformation campaign and false statement”.

The media office instead said it was an attempt “to hold the government apparatus in Gaza responsible for the disruption of truck entry” and that the fee was a voluntary payment to a fund providing aid for those in need, such as widows and orphans.

It also said that cash payments were encouraged due to what it described as an acute cash shortage in the war-torn territory, but were never a mandatory requirement.

The halt to commercial shipments, including fruit and winter clothing, cuts off a key source of food and other critical supplies as fears mount ahead of the encroaching winter.

Aid groups generally bring in staples such as flour, while merchants import more perishable foods like fruits and meat, according to data released earlier this year by COGAT.

The suspension is raising fears about affordability, with humanitarian workers saying a combination of aid and a robust commercial market is needed to keep prices under control.

“The humanitarian sector on its own cannot meet the needs of all the people,” said Shaina Low, a spokesperson for the Norwegian Refugee Council. “The markets need to be functioning.”

The head of Gaza’s private truckers union, Nahed Sheheiber, denied the Israeli narrative, saying: “The Israeli coordinator is claiming that Gaza’s merchants are responsible, but the truth is that the Israelis are the ones who imposed the restrictions.”

Following COGAT’s announcement, Sheheiber’s union met with Gaza’s Ministry of Economy to express concern and say Israel was citing fees levied by the ministry as a pretext to cut off commercial goods.

A global hunger monitor in July warned that more than two-thirds of people in Gaza could face acute hunger by the year-end.

Israel is obliged under a US-mediated agreement to allow a minimum of 600 trucks carrying humanitarian aid to enter Gaza each day.

Diplomats say that far fewer than 600 trucks normally enter Gaza each day. Sheheiber said the figure was closer to 300, with two-thirds carrying commercial goods.
sources.headline: Israel halts commercial goods from entering Gaza; Hamas denies tax claims

stories.headline: France and Germany back looser EU car-emissions rules and a 'made in Europe' plan

sources.body: France and Germany have backed looser EU emissions rules for carmakers and agreed to include Britain in a “made in Europe” scheme, in a provisional deal reached Thursday that could reshape the bloc’s automotive and climate policies.
sources.headline: France and Germany agree to ease EU car emissions rules in new deal

sources.body:
França i Alemanya han tancat un preacord perquè es protegeixi més la indústria de l'automòbil europea , davant el tsunami de cotxes xinesos que envaeixen el continent. El preacord s'ha filtrat en el marc de la cimera europea de caps d'estat i de govern que s'està fent a Brussel·les.

Ho ha fet l'agència France-Presse, tot i que el 7 d'octubre el diari alemany Bild ja ho avançava en termes similars. En tot cas, el que s'hagi parlat s'ha de traduir en un acord a escala europea, i ho ha d'aplicar la Comissió Europea. En concret, es tracta de dues grans decisions .

La primera decisió és suavitzar les mesures mediambientals de la mateixa Comissió Europea i el seu Pacte Verd. Fins ara s'establia que els cotxes europeus havien de reduir les emissions de CO₂ dels motors de combustió en un 90% d'aquí al 2035. Això queda igual.

Tanmateix, en el 10% restant és on hi ha la diferència. Si fins ara es deia que aquest 10% s'havia de compensar d'una manera o altra, ara s'elimina. La raó seria que cada cop s'utilitzen "més carburants sostenibles, com per exemple els biocarburants".

Simplificant, es podria dir que aquest capítol és el que més interessava als alemanys i a la seva indústria, sobretot al grup Volkswagen, directament afectat per la competència dels utilitaris xinesos.

La segona mesura és una mica més complexa de definir, però és la torna que els francesos (amb altres paraules, el grup Stellantis) han demanat als alemanys, que en poden sortir més afectats.

Es tracta d'establir un principi de preferència europea més estricta en el sector de l'automòbil. Aquesta és una proposta molt defensada per la Comissió Europea: es tracta d' obligar les empreses de sectors considerats estratègics (si s'han beneficiat d'ajudes públiques a Europa) a proveir-se de components fabricats únicament a Europa . O també al Regne Unit i Noruega.

I la indústria de components, la indústria auxiliar de l'automòbil, no és cap broma. I és que genera més llocs de treball que les mateixes marques. Espanya, per exemple, és una potència mundial en aquest camp.

Davant aquesta proposta, els alemanys van estar defensant durant molt de temps el concepte "Made with Europe" (és a dir, "fet amb Europa"). Ho van fer per justificar que els components poguessin acabar venint una mica de tot arreu.

Especialment, que vinguessin de la Xina i de Turquia, on la indústria alemanya té molts interessos, tant industrials com financers i accionarials. Per cert, el "Made with..." va ser el lema favorit dels xinesos en aquells feliços anys 2000 , quan es lligaven gossos amb llonganisses.

Un apunt final. L'"exclusiva" d'aquest dijous ja es va avançar el 7 d'octubre. Com dèiem al principi, per part del diari Bild.

La reacció de les grans marques europees a borsa va ser eufòrica . El valor de les accions a borsa del grup Volkswagen, Stellantis i Renault (no és cap casualitat) van pujar de cop un 5%. Tot sigui dit, venien de baixades espectaculars al llarg d'aquest any, d'entre un 20% i un 50%.

Tot i això, en els set dies que han passat, aquella eufòria no s'ha concretat. Stellantis i Volkswagen van pujar, van baixar i ara estan, fins i tot, una mica per sota d'on eren el dia 6. A Renault sí que li ha anat una mica millor. Veurem com reacciona la borsa aquest divendres.
sources.headline: França i Alemanya pacten augmentar la protecció als cotxes europeus sobre els fabricats a la Xina

stories.headline: Maduro and his wife plead not guilty to new US torture charges

sources.body:
Venezuela's former leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, appeared in court on Thursday to plead not guilty to new charges of conspiracy to commit torture.

The US government initially accused Maduro of narco-terrorism, drug trafficking and weapons-related offenses, before adding new charges against him and Flores last week.

Maduro and Flores were captured in January during a US military raid, after which they were taken to New York, where they remain in jail.

The couple has pleaded not guilty to the allegations and both have argued to have the case thrown out on the grounds that they qualify for sovereign immunity. Their trial is scheduled for June 2027.

In a new indictment last week, government prosecutors alleged Maduro and Flores "created and maintained a violent system of repression" that saw "thousands of Venezuelans" killed, harassed, and tortured.

Nicolas Maduro denied the new charges brought against him by the US government, telling a court on Thursday he denied the "false accusations and false testimony against me."

"I reject this document entirely," Maduro said in Spanish through a translator.

Judge Alvin Hellerstein interrupted Maduro, and declared the court would enter a plea of not guilty for Maduro.

"I am completely innocent. I am not guilty," Flores said through a translator.

Maduro and Flores wore beige jail uniforms and both appear to have lost weight during their detention in Brooklyn.

The alleged torture methods included "electric shock, asphyxiation, rape, forced nudity, prolonged isolation, starvation, punishment cells, and psychological torture", the indictment states.

The US also accused Maduro of authorising the use of torture "against specific individuals" and alleges US citizens were tortured under this system.

Prosecutors already have accused Maduro, his wife and son, and their accomplices of engaging in a cocaine-trafficking conspiracy and partnering with cartels designated as terrorist groups.

Maduro previously called such charges a tool to further "imperial" plans for getting access to Venezuela's rich oil reserves.

He and his wife's lawyers have argued that Maduro is the leader of a sovereign country and therefore immune from prosecution. They contend the US taking him by force is illegal.

Flores unsuccessfully petitioned a judge to allow her to be released on bond while she awaited trial, arguing she had heart problems and other health issues while detained at the notorious Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn.
sources.headline: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York

sources.body:
Rewritten indictment accuses ex-Venezuela president and wife Cilia Flores of leading campaign of torture

Nicolás Maduro insisted on Thursday during an appearance in a New York court that torture allegations in a rewritten drug trafficking indictment against the deposed Venezuelan president and his wife were “false accusations”.

Maduro, shackled at the ankles, was brought to court to face the new charges accusing the couple of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of victims, including three Americans.

Judge Alvin K Hellerstein entered a not-guilty plea on behalf of Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores. They were seized from their Caracas home by the US military in a night-time raid in January.

Hellerstein announced that he was entering the plea on behalf of Maduro after Maduro twice responded to the judge’s request to enter a plea by criticizing the indictment, saying it contained “false accusations and false testimony”. Maduro spoke through an interpreter.

Attorney Barry Pollack said when the charges were announced last week that Maduro, 63, denied them and “looks forward to his day in court”.

According to the rewritten indictment, Maduro oversaw a violent torture system that beat, asphyxiated and delivered electric shocks to its victims. He is accused of personally recommending torture methods, receiving updates on specific victims’ treatment and threatening to kill one prisoner’s child as a form of psychological torture.

Flores, 70, a former attorney general, helped develop the repressive system and ordered the torture of some specific people, the indictment alleges.

When she was asked to enter a plea, she said through an interpreter: “I am completely innocent. I am not guilty.”

Maduro, who served as Venezuela’s president from 2013 until his capture in January, has been under investigation for years by the international criminal court over allegations of crimes against humanity, tied to his crackdown on opponents. He has always denied wrongdoing.

Prosecutors told the judge during the hearing that lawyers on both sides want the trial date moved from 1 June to 14 June.

Torture is a crime under international law and can be prosecuted outside the country where the abuse occurred and regardless of the victims’ nationality. But the prosecution of foreign officials in the US is exceedingly rare, having been tried only a few times, including against the son of the former Liberian president Charles Taylor, Russians responsible for war crimes in Ukraine and a former prison warden in Bashar Assad’s Syria.

Earlier this year, Maduro and his wife pleaded not guilty in the US drug case, which said they conspired to flood the US with cocaine. Their attorneys say the case should be dismissed on immunity grounds because they were the leader and first lady of a foreign country.

The revised indictment covers allegations of torture stretching back to Maduro’s ascent to power in 2013, when he took over as president from his mentor Hugo Chávez, who died of cancer that year.
sources.headline: Nicolás Maduro tells New York court new torture allegations are ‘false’

sources.body: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty on Thursday to new torture charges brought against them by US authorities, calling them “false allegations". The couple has been held in a New York jail since their capture in early January and is facing a new indictment accusing them of conspiring to torture political opponents and US citizens.
sources.headline: Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro and wife Cilia Flores deny US torture charges as 'false accusations'

stories.headline: Democratic Senate candidates open major fundraising leads over Republican rivals

sources.body: Republican Senate candidates are hurting for cash. Nearly every Democratic candidate in battleground Senate races outraised their GOP opponent from July through September. And in some cases, the disparities were stark. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico trounced Republican Ken Paxton $60.2 million to $10.2 million in their main campaign accounts.  In Georgia, Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff raised $33.1 million to Rep. Mike Collins’ nearly $2.8 million.  In North Carolina, Democrat Roy Cooper raised $12.2 million to Michael Whatley’s $2.1 million.  In Michigan, Democrat Abdul El-Sayed hauled in roughly $33 million to former Rep. Mike Rogers’ nearly $10 million.  In Maine, Democrat Troy Jackson raised $20.5 million to GOP Sen. Susan Collins’ $5.2 million.  In Ohio, Democratic former Sen. Sherrod Brown hauled in $23.1 million to GOP Sen. Jon Husted’s $4.8 million. In Iowa, Josh Turek raised $13.9 million to Republican Rep. Ashley Hinson’s nearly $3.3 million. In Alaska, Democratic former Rep. Mary Peltola raked in $17 million to GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan’s nearly $2.7 million.  In New Hampshire, Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas brought in $8.1 million to Republican former Sen. John E. Sununu’s $1.5 million.   And in Kansas, Democrat Adam Hamilton raised nearly $9.9 million to GOP Sen. Roger Marshall’s just $866,000. Across those 10 Senate races, the Democratic campaigns raised more than five times as much as the Republican ones. Put another way: Talarico alone raised more than all those Republicans combined. Marshall and Whatley each started October with less than $1 million left in the bank. Mike Collins wasn’t much better-positioned, entering the final weeks of the election with just over $1 million cash on hand. These numbers do not include joint fundraising committees, which allow candidates to raise money and may have some more cash that has not yet been transferred to the campaigns. Democrats have consistently outraised Republicans on the candidate level this cycle. But the yawning gaps heading into the midterm’s home stretch stand as the latest example of the deteriorating environment for the GOP. And while GOP outside groups have significantly more money than Democrats, this candidate cash advantage matters because candidates get TV ads for much cheaper rates, letting their dollars stretch much farther. To underscore how lopsided some of these figures are: At least half a dozen House Democratic challengers raised over $3 million in the third quarter — a sum higher than several GOP Senate incumbents. There are some silver linings for the GOP. In Minnesota, Republican Michele Tafoya raised $4.9 million to Democratic Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan’s $4.3 million. Tafoya started the month with $2.1 million to Flanagan’s $1.5 million. Sullivan, Husted, Hinson, Rogers and Susan Collins all entered October with millions more in cash on hand than their Democratic opponents. And Republicans are getting air cover from GOP super PACs bankrolled by billionaire Elon Musk and President Donald Trump’s MAGA Inc. that have pumped hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterms in recent weeks. Musk was revealed on Thursday as the primary funder of Texas PAC, which has spent $131 million so far boosting Paxton and attacking Talarico. Musk gave $158 million to Senate Republicans’ super PAC arm last quarter, the filings showed, with the group in turn transferring the funds to the pro-Paxton PAC. Republicans are also benefitting from a recent Supreme Court ruling that allows party committees to spend unlimited sums in coordination with candidates, allowing the National Republican Senatorial Committee to offset at least some of the differences. Since the tranche of reports filed Thursday only cover until Sept. 30, the full scope of each candidates’ coffers is unknown. But there are other signs that some are strapped for cash in the final sprint: Whatley has gone dark on television , a clear indication of him running low on funds even as his campaign insists it’s a temporary pause.
sources.headline: Senate Republicans are getting smoked in fundraising

stories.headline: Trump attacks fellow Republicans as Ken Paxton struggles in Texas Senate race

sources.body: President Donald Trump is blaming fellow Republicans as his endorsed candidate, Ken Paxton, appears to be in a fierce struggle for a Senate seat in Texas with Democratic challenger James Talarico in a state the GOP has long taken for granted. Trump, in a lengthy post to Truth Social Thursday, singled out longtime Republican strategist Karl Rove and Sen. John Cornyn, the incumbent who failed to secure the president's endorsement in a heated primary. Rove and Cornyn, Trump said, are doing “everything possible” to make it harder for Paxton to defeat Talarico, a state lawmaker and Presbyterian seminarian who is making a suprisingly strong run for Senate in deep red Texas. “They are hurting Texas and, more importantly, hurting the United States of America!” Trump wrote. “If Ken Paxton loses, it will be because of WEAK and INEFFECTIVE Political Hacks like John Cornyn and Karl Rove, who have ineffectively opposed me for my entire political career.” Cornyn, a longtime fixture in Texas politics, lost his bid for reelection in a contentious Republican primary in which he and his supporters portrayed Paxton as a deeply flawed candidate. As Election Day approaches, public polling over the past two months has shown Talarico with a narrow edge against Paxton, the state's attorney general. Trump urged his supporters to back Paxton. “Your favorite President (ME!) is asking all of those who supported Senator John Cornyn to UNITE, and immediately switch your support to Ken Paxton,” Trump said. “He will be a Great Senator, just like he is a Great Attorney General. " The race has also become one of the most expensive non-presidential battles. Talarico raised $64 million this summer — the largest third-quarter haul of any Senate candidate in history. He has raised more than $134 million since launching his campaign last year. Paxton raised $18 million in the third quarter of 2026 and last month announced a new $20 million ad buy . Earlier this month, though, a Trump operative told POLITICO that MAGA Inc. and its affiliates are could spend nearly $45 million on direct mail, TV and digital advertising in Texas through Oct. 12. Already, $235 million has been spent by outside conservative groups and party committees against Talarico as national Republicans scramble to boost Paxton. Some Republicans have grown concerned that the cost of the Texas race is diverting money needed in other states and have expressed frustrations with Paxton after leaked audio showed him blaming Trump for his woes. Trump easily won Texas in 2024 , winning just over 56% of the vote. But concerns about Republicans’ chances this November have surged as the president’s approval rating plummets.
sources.headline: Trump lashes out at Republicans as Ken Paxton struggles in Texas

stories.headline: Two women file sex-trafficking lawsuit against former congressman Matt Gaetz

sources.body: TALLAHASSEE, Florida — Two women this week sued former GOP Florida Rep. Matt Gaetz and two others — including a former state legislator — in federal court and accused the men of engaging in an alleged sex trafficking scheme during a time when Gaetz was still in Congress. The lawsuit, which seeks damages from Gaetz and other defendants, was filed in Orlando by two women who were in their early 20s when they first met Gaetz. The women are not named in the lawsuit. The details mirror allegations that were at the center of a House Ethics Committee probe that found Gaetz had sex with a minor, solicited prostitutes and used illegal drugs. “The defendants collectively used their public office, power, and wealth to prey on the economic vulnerability of the plaintiffs to commit the acts outlined below,” states the 38-page lawsuit. That House probe helped derail Gaetz’s bid to become attorney general under President Donald Trump. He resigned from his Northwest Florida congressional seat to seek the post but decided to withdraw his name ahead of a potentially messy confirmation battle in the Senate. Gaetz, who has repeatedly denied he ever had sex with a minor, said he would vigorously contest the allegations in the lawsuit. “I look forward to taking the plaintiffs’ depositions because much of the conduct alleged against me is false,” Gaetz said in a text message. “The lawsuit relies almost exclusively on a Congressional committee report that didn’t allow me to confront my accusers. Now I will finally have that chance.” The civil suit is the latest development in the long-running scandal involving Gaetz, a former ally of Trump who has continuously denied any involvement in underage sex or trafficking of women after news broke in 2021 that the Justice Department was investigating him. The lawsuit this week by Jane Doe 1 and Jane Doe 2 was first reported by the Miami Herald . It alleges that Gaetz and former Seminole County Tax Collector Joel Greenberg “coordinated the recruitment, payments, drugs and travel to obtain commercial sex acts from young women.” The lawsuit includes former Florida legislator and lobbyist Chris Dorworth because his Central Florida home was the site of a party where he allegedly “participated in the activities alleged there.” Greenberg is serving an 11-year federal sentence after he pleaded guilty to multiple federal offenses including underage sex trafficking of a minor and wire fraud. Greenberg cooperated with federal investigators who were probing Gaetz but the U.S. Department of Justice closed the investigation without filing charges. The lawsuit says it “arises from the recruitment and sexual exploitation” that occurred from 2017 through January 2019 and included trips to various locations such as Las Vegas, New York City and the Bahamas. It accuses Gaetz and Greenberg of making promises to help the two women financially or with college bills. “They led her to believe they would resolve her financial needs as long as she continued to perform sexual acts for them and their associates,” the lawsuit states about Jane Doe 1. “They used the age, wealth and political power gap between themselves and Jane Doe 1 to keep her compliant and silent.” Jane Doe 2, the lawsuit states, was “paid less” than promised and “through this pattern defendants caused Jane Doe 2 to believe she would lose her education and serious financial harm if she stopped performing sexual acts.” Stencer Kuvin, a West Palm Beach attorney representing the two women, said in an email that federal law designed to protect sex trafficking victims has a 10-year statute of limitations “which potentially could run [out] next year based upon the allegations in the complaint.” Gaetz, a firebrand and ally of Trump, was once seen as a potential candidate for Florida governor or attorney general. Since he left Congress, he has hosted his own show on the One America News Network and he was appointed to the board of a nonprofit charged with distributing proceeds from a settlement Florida received after the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill along the Gulf Coast.
sources.headline: 2 women accuse Matt Gaetz of sex trafficking in new lawsuit

stories.headline: Spain's electoral board opens another case against Sánchez over campaigning from Moncloa

sources.body:
La Junta Electoral Central ( JEC ) ha acordado este jueves abrir un expediente sancionador al presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez , por la rueda de prensa que ofreció en la Moncloa el pasado 6 de octubre, al día siguiente de convocar los comicios del 29 de noviembre, al considerar que esa comparecencia pudo vulnerar la legislación electoral que impide hacer electoralismo con medios públicos.

Se trata de la rueda de prensa ofrecida en Moncloa tras el Consejo de Ministros que aprobó los dos decretos ley sobre vivienda que habían sido derogados la semana anterior por el Congreso.

El PP denunció a Sánchez por considerar que había vulnerado la Ley Electoral al utilizar la sede de la Presidencia del Gobierno para dar "un mítin del PSOE", pues expuso supuestos logros del Ejecutivo, descalificó a la oposición y dirigió mensajes propios de campaña electoral a la ciudadanía, "incluyendo la petición de una mayoría parlamentaria más amplia".

Los 'populares' también pidieron la retirada del vídeo de esa comparecencia la web oficial de la Moncloa y que se instara a la totalidad del Gobierno a abstenerse de realizar manifestaciones de esta índole en periodo preelectoral.

Tras conocerse la noticia, el secretario general del PP, Miguel Tellado, ha reaccionado en redes sociales. "Sánchez es un tramposo profesional pero no le vamos a pasar ni una. La Junta Electoral le abre expediente, tras la denuncia del PP por dar un mitin desde el Palacio de La Moncloa. Seguimos", ha expresado en X.

La JEC ha constatado que en aquella comparecencia Sánchez no se limitó a informar sobre el contenido de los decretos leyes aprobados , sino que introdujo criticas a la oposición, presumió de los logros del Gobierno y defendió incluso la necesidad de "obtener una nueva mayoría parlamentaria".

Es decir, considera que el jefe del Ejecutivo pudo haber incurrido en la prohibición establecida en el artículo 50.2 de la Ley Orgánica del Régimen Electoral General (LOREG) y el deber de neutralidad política que deben respetar los poderes públicos durante los periodos electorales".

Por eso, el organismo arbitral atiende la petición del PP y pide la retirada de la web de la Presidencia del Gobierno y otros canales oficiales de las declaraciones de esas declaraciones valorativas. También insta a Sánchez a que, durante lo que resta de periodo electoral, "observe el deber de neutralidad política exigible a los poderes públicos y se abstenga de realizar manifestaciones contrarias al artículo 50.2 de la LOREG en actos institucionales".

En este punto, le avisa de que "la reiteración de tales conductas podrá dar lugar a las correspondientes responsabilidades sancionadoras, sin perjuicio de las consecuencias jurídicas que pudieran derivarse del cumplimiento de los requerimientos expresos" de la JEC.

Además, la Junta recalca que Sánchez "debía conocer suficientemente las exigencias de la legislación electoral en materia de neutralidad institucional", pues la JEC ya le ha impuesto varias sanciones por sus manifestaciones en actos institucionales incluidas comparecencias posteriores al Consejo de Ministros.
sources.headline: La Junta Electoral abre un nuevo expediente sancionador a S�nchez por hacer partidismo desde Moncloa

sources.body:
La Junta Electoral Central (JEC) ha obert un expedient sancionador al president del govern espanyol, Pedro Sánchez, per la roda de premsa que va fer a la Moncloa el 6 d'octubre, l'endemà de convocar les eleccions generals del 29 de novembre.

Es tracta de la roda oferta després del Consell de Ministres, en què es van aprovar els dos decrets llei sobre habitatge que havien estat derogats la setmana anterior pel Congrés.

La JEC considera que la compareixença podria haver vulnerat la legislació electoral, que impedeix fer electoralisme amb mitjans públics. Per això, investigarà el cas i si es conclou que sí, pot derivar en una sanció d'entre 300 i 3.000 euros.

El PP, així com S'ha Acabat la Festa, va denunciar Sánchez en considerar que havia vulnerat la llei en fer servir la seu de la Presidència del Govern per "un míting del PSOE". El partit que lidera Feijóo apunta que Sánchez va exposar fites de l'Executiu, desqualificar l'oposició i dirigir missatges de campanya electoral als ciutadans, "incloent-hi la petició d'una majoria parlamentària més àmplia".

Els populars també han demanat retirar el vídeo d'aquesta compareixença de la web oficial de La Moncloa.

La JEC no inclou a l'expedient la declaració institucional del dia anterior, denunciada per Vox, quan Sánchez va anunciar la dissolució de les Corts i la convocatòria d'eleccions anticipades, i va instar a triar entre "l'onada ultradretana" i la justícia social.

Com que encara no estava en vigor el decret, no havia començat el període electoral ni s'havien posat en marxa les restriccions. No obstant, sí que censura la difusió d'aquelles declaracions als canals oficials ja en període electoral.

Amb aquest, Sánchez ja ha rebut cinc expedients sancionadors de la Junta Electoral Central. Acumula multes econòmiques que sumen un import de 6.600 euros per vulnerar el principi de neutralitat institucional que exigeix ​​la LOREG en diferents períodes electorals.

La primera sanció, de 500 euros, se li va imposar el gener del 2020 per concedir una entrevista televisiva en període electoral al palau de La Moncloa. L'octubre del 2023 se'l va sancionar amb 2.200 euros per fer manifestacions amb contingut electoralista en una roda de premsa a Brussel·les després d'un Consell Europeu.

Una altra multa va arribar el 2024 , per aprofitar un acte oficial per defensar el socialista Salvador Illa a la campanya de les eleccions catalanes. L'últim expedient se li va obrir a les eleccions extremenyes per carregar contra els pactes de PP i Vox.
sources.headline: La Junta Electoral obre expedient a Sánchez per un acte a La Moncloa amb les eleccions ja convocades

stories.headline: Spain's intelligence service submits report on mass entry into Ceuta to investigating judge

sources.body: <p>La jueza de la Audiencia Nacional María Tardón pidió informes prácticamente a todos los cuerpos implicados, de un modo o de otro, en la defensa de la frontera de Ceuta. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/la-jueza-moviliza-18-unidades-policiales-y-tres-organismos-de-inteligencia-para-investigar-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/la-jueza-moviliza-18-unidades-policiales-y-tres-organismos-de-inteligencia-para-investigar-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html">En total, movilizó a 21 unidades policiales y militares</a> para conocer quién coordinó, financió y decidió la entrada masiva de unas 80.000 personas en España el pasado 30 de julio. Aunque la togada todavía está a la espera de mucha de la información solicitada, el Centro Nacional de Inteligencia (CNI) ha presentado ya la documentación requerida, según confirman fuentes jurídicas a EL PAÍS. De momento, la instructora no ha dirigido la investigación contra nadie en específico y se ha limitado a escuchar a varios testigos, como el que fuera jefe de gabinete del delegado del Gobierno, Gonzalo Sanz, o el expresidente de Ceuta, Juan Jesús Vivas. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-10-16/el-cni-entrega-a-la-jueza-tardon-el-informe-sobre-lo-ocurrido-en-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
sources.headline: El CNI entrega a la jueza Tardón el informe sobre lo ocurrido en Ceuta

stories.headline: Defence ministry refers recordings of soldiers mocking assaults on migrants in Ceuta to justice authorities

sources.body:
Los legionarios que participaron en un vídeo del agitador extremista Vito Quiles se juegan de 15 a 30 días de arresto

La ministra de Defensa, Margarita Robles, saluda a un teniente coronel de la Legión durante una visita a las tropas destinadas en Ceuta en febrero de 2026 / ET - COMGECEU

A la celebración del 12 de octubre con un desfile militar sin apenas incidencias le sucede una semana con problemas para Defensa y su ministra, recién confirmada en el puesto 2 de la lista del PSOE por Madrid. Por un lado, nuevas evidencias publicadas acerca de conductas violentas contra inmigrantes supuestamente cometidas por militares destinados en Ceuta; por otro, la difusión de un vídeo del agitador ultra Vito Quiles jaleado por legionarios, el mismo día de la Fiesta Nacional de España.

Ambos casos afloran escandalosamente en precampaña, y la titular del ministerio, Margarita Robles , ha tratado de mostrar la máxima proactividad, si bien en el primero no hay una investigación interna abierta, y en el segundo sí.

Los legionarios que participaron en el vídeo propagandístico que rodó Vito Quiles el 12 de octubre se juegan de 15 a 30 días de arresto . Asesores de la cúpula ministerio consideran que los militares que se dejaron grabar vitoreando al agitador y jaleando su propuesta “¡A por los rojos!” han violado el régimen disciplinario militar rompiendo la estricta neutralidad política que se les exige a los militares.

Los mencionados asesores señalan como falta grave “efectuar con publicidad manifestaciones o expresar opiniones que supongan infracción del deber de neutralidad política o sindical. Fundar un partido político o sindicato, así como constituir una asociación que (...) conculque los deberes de neutralidad política o sindical . Afiliarse a este tipo de organizaciones o promover sus actividades, publicitarlas, así como inducir o invitar a otros militares a que lo hagan”, entre otras conductas descritas en el artículo 32 de la Ley Orgánica de Régimen Disciplinario de las Fuerzas Armadas.

Por orden de la ministra, el Ejército de Tierra tiene ya en marcha pesquisas sobre las imágenes difundidas por Vito Quiles en redes sociales el 12 de octubre. Fuentes relacionadas con el proceso explican que el primer paso es descartar que el vídeo esté trucado . Más adelante se tratará de aclarar si Quiles entró por invitación en el bus fletado por Defensa para llevar a los legionarios al desfile del 12-O, o se coló por propia iniciativa.

El agitador de ultraderecha Vito Quiles, vitoreado por legionarios en un bus fletado por Defensa para el desfile del pasado 12 de octubre / Perfil en X de Vito Quiles

Las otros castigos del arco de penas previstas para personal del Ejército por este comportamiento son una sanción económica de ocho a quince días de sueldo, la pérdida del destino o la baja si se está en un centro docente militar. “Vito Quiles escogió con quién sacarse el vídeo - sospechan en el entorno de la ministra-. No fue al bus de la Guardia Real, precisamente, o al de la Policía Nacional , sino al de la Legión”.
sources.headline: Defensa insta al mando militar a investigar conductas violentas y manifestaciones ultras de los soldados

sources.body:
El Ministeri de Defensa ha enviat al jutjat de guàrdia de Ceuta i a la Fiscalia la notícia d'elDiario.es en què apareixen àudios de militars parlant sobre agressions a immigrants. Els documents sonors que recull la informació periodística descriuen cops i tractes vexatoris a migrants a Ceuta.

D'aquesta manera, diu en un comunicat el ministeri, col·labora amb la investigació del que anomena " suposades conductes delictives " amb l'objectiu de preservar "el bon nom de les Forces Armades".

Entre els missatges publicats a l'article, hi ha converses d'un grup de tres militars destinats a la ciutat autònoma del 21 de setembre. Parlen d' agafar els immigrants "per sorpresa" . Descriuen agressions en to de mofa, com ara: " Sense guants mola més , perquè sona. Però amb guants fa mal ", diuen mentre riuen.

En un altre fragment d'àudio, un dels militars explica la reacció d'un immigrant després de pegar-li una bufetada . "Li han saltat les llàgrimes i li dic: 'Ara estàs plorant?'. " Un altre dels membres de l'exèrcit afegeix a la conversa: "És que sembla que se les busquin, sembla que els agradi cobrar. "

L'article d'elDiario.es parla sobre l'actuació d'una altra unitat, el Grup dels Regulars, de la qual un dels militars dels àudios hauria estat testimoni. Hi descriu una "prova" en què feien que un immigrant marroquí agredís altres immigrants. "Els Regulars s'ho han passat bé de veritat, n'han ficat un i li han dit: 'Si no li claves fort i no crida, cobres tu . Al que pegui i cridi, cobrarà fort. I al que va cridar, el van inflar a hòsties. "

En canvi, quan el migrant que rep cops aguanta el dolor i no crida , qui rep és l'immigrant a qui han obligat a clavar els cops. I rep per part de tothom. "Em volia quedar, fan coses molt guapes , em va recordar les proves de "Saw". Heu vist la pel·lícula "Saw" ?", afegeix el militar que explica la prova.

Amnistia Internacional considera que aquests fets es poden considerar tortura, com explica el director de l'ONG a Espanya, Esteban Beltrán. "Hi ha un element d'humiliació , que és un grau especial de tortures, segons marca el Tribunal Europeu de Drets Humans, és un càstig, un acarnissament, en la forma de maltractar la persona, ni tan sols hi ha una raó amagada per buscar informació, hi ha una gravetat de les ferides important", explica Beltrán.

Tracte cruel, inhumà i degradant perquè busca la humiliació no només amb cops i agressions físiques, sinó també amb el que Beltrán qualifica de " tortura psicològica ".

I tot, afegeix, de forma aparentment gratuïta. " No hi ha motius legítims , com la legítima defensa ni portar persones als tribunals, sinó que són operacions de càstig i reflecteixen un patró: no saben si responen ordres o no, però ho fan de nit, els porten a altres llocs sovint en maleters i actuen en grup, no són fets aïllats ", explica el representant d'Amnistia Internacional.

De fet, Amnistia Internacional ja va denunciar tracte inhumà i degradant a immigrants a Ceuta fa setmanes. En el seu informe, l'ONG aportava documentació gràfica de lesions com ara traus al cap, cames plenes de contusions o blaus a les espatlles provocades per membres de l'exèrcit espanyol.
sources.headline: Defensa envia a la justícia els àudios de militars fent mofa d'agressions a migrants a Ceuta

stories.headline: Isabel Allende wins the 75th Premio Planeta for 'La hora antes del alba'

sources.body: L’escriptora xilena Isabel Allende ha guanyat la 75a edició del Premi Planeta , amb la novel·la La hora antes del alba. Presidit pels reis d’Espanya, el guardó literari a una obra inèdita més ben dotat del món, amb 1.000.000 d’euros , s’ha lliurat per primer cop en una gran vetllada al Pavelló 1 de la Fira de Barcelona a Montjuïc. Segons l’organització, el MNAC havia quedat petit tenint en compte “una assistència que superava àmpliament les previsions inicials d’aforament”. Neboda del president Salvador Allende , Isabel Allende (Lima, Perú, 2 d’agost del 1942) és una de les escriptores més llegides de les lletres espanyoles, amb unes vendes que superen els 51 milions d’exemplars, amb traduccions a 27 idiomes. Va començar treballant com a periodista, per bé que quan es va exiliar a Caracas va decidir dedicar-se completament a la literatura. La casa de los espíritus va ser la seva primera novel·la, que la va convertir en una de les escriptores clau de la narrativa llatinoamericana.  Gran part de la seva producció s’emmarca en l’anomenar realisme màgic , tot i que ha conreat també la novel·la policíaca i la històrica. El seu estil és de notable claredat i senzillesa, amb un marcat component feminista. Són també seves les novel·les Eva Luna , Inés del alma mía ,  La isla bajo el mar  i  El amante japonés . Actualment resident a Califòrnia, ha obtingut nombrosos guardons, com el Premi Nacional de Literatura de Xile el 2010. El valencià Sergio Hernández, finalista del Planeta L’escriptor i guionista Sergio Hernández (València, 1994) ha quedat finalista, amb la novel·la La añoranza ; un premi dotat amb 200.000 euros. És filòleg hispànic per la Universitat de València i titulat en guió pel Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia de Roma. El 2015 va publicar 365 primeras citas mentre treballava com a guionista radiofònic i abans de fer el salt a RTVE. És autor de la novel·la La última canción de primavera (2019) i Backhome un còmic en clau de thriller, amb dibuix de Toni Caballero i editat per Planeta Manga, que ha venut 250.000 exemplars. També és coautor amb Lolita Aldea del manga futurista Hysteria . Foto: EFE El Pavelló 1 de la Fira s’ha vestit de gala per celebrar els tres quarts de segle del Premi Planeta. Llums d’aranya, espelmes, mostradors amb els 74 títols premiats en edicions anteriors o grans plafons simulant pàgines manuscrites han rebut als més de 1.400 convidats a l’acte. Com és habitual en el cas del Premi Planeta, la nit ha començat amb els nou inèdits seleccionats per a l’ocasió (n’havien de ser deu, però un va quedar desqualificat el ser publicat amb un altre segell editorial). Al llarg de la vetllada, s’han anat descartant els contendents en diverses votacions del jurat fins arribar al podi final: Isabel Allende, guanyadora, i Sergio Hernández, finalista del Premi Planeta en el seu 75è aniversari. També et pot interessar Maruja Torres: “Ser feliç és la millor venjança, malgrat tot” Víctor Giralt Jonama 2 minuts de lectura Les novetats del Premi Planeta La seu de l’acte no ha estat l’única novetat d’aquesta edició, que ha renovat dos dels membres del jurat: d’una banda Paloma Sánchez-Garnica , escriptora, guanyadora del guardó el 2024 i finalista tres anys abans; de l’altra Javier Sierra, mereixedor del premi el 2017 . S’han incorporat en substitució de José Manuel Blecua, traspassat el mes de maig, i Juan Eslava Galán. A més, per primera vegada en la seva història, el Premi Planeta atorga un trofeu al finalista: una rèplica a escala més reduïda del premi del guanyador. En aquesta edició s’ha tornat a batre el rècord d’originals presentats amb 1.424 inèdits : 778 rebuts de l’estat espanyol, 383 de l’Amèrica del Sud, 151 de l’Amèrica del Nord i 17 de l’Amèrica Central. També et pot interessar Nerea Pérez de las Heras: “No hem de defensar tantíssim la normalitat” Laura Sangrà Herrero 2 minuts de lectura
sources.headline: Isabel Allende guanya el Premi Planeta 2026

sources.body:
sabel Allende, tras ganar anoche el premio Planeta, flanqueada por los Reyes y José Creuheras

Es la escritora viva en lengua española más leída del mundo. A lo largo de su carrera ha ganado todo tipo de reconocimientos, como el Premio Iberoamericano de Letras José Donoso o la Medalla Presidencial de la Libertad, la mayor distinción civil que otorga el gobierno de Estados Unidos. Y a sus 84 años, Isabel Allende demuestra que está en plena forma, pues esta noche ha añadido otro trofeo a su palmarés: el Planeta.

Y no con una historia menor, pues ha anunciado que la obra con la que se ha presentado al premio bajo el seudónimo de Luz Ventura es nada más y nada menos que la secuela de la que fue su primera novela, La casa de los espíritus . Una historia que llegará a las librerías con el título de  La hora antes del alba . El finalista es Sergio Hernández con la novela  La añoranza , que sigue a una joven que se enamora de un traductor francés que termina vinculado con un supuesto plan para asesinar a Antonio Machado.

“Nunca me presenté a un concurso para evitar la humillación de quedar en la cola, pero decidí correr el riesgo porque era un desafío, como volver a casarse a los 80. A mi edad hay muy poco que perder”, ha agradecido tras una larga ovación.

La escritora ha recordado que hace 45 años que publicó su primera novela y, “durante todo este tiempo he recibido innumerables mensajes de lectores que me preguntan qué paso con Alba”, nieta de Esteban Trueba y Clara del Valle, encarcelada, torturada y violada durante la dictadura y a la que convierte en protagonista de esta secuela, que ocurre unos pocos años después. La joven regresa embarazada a la casa familiar y, si bien el miedo y el dolor la atenazan, su deseo de ayudar a los más desfavorecidos es más fuerte.

“Mis novelas dejan semillas y, cuando alguna empieza a molestarme, sé que ha llegado el momento de retomar y escribir. Y eso ocurre ahora, porque veo tantas democracias amenazadas por el nacionalismo y el fascismo que vuelvo a sentir el temor que me obligó a salir d mi país después del golpe militar en 1973”.

El nombre de los ganadores se ha hecho público durante el transcurso de una cena en la Fira Barcelona de Montjuïc presidida por los reyes. Felipe VI ha inaugurado la gala destacando que tanto el Grupo Planeta como su premio “han contribuido de manera decisiva a enriquecer nuestro panorama cultural y a darle proyección”.

En la ceremonia se han dejado ver escritores como Alana S. Portero, Alicia Giménez Bartlett, Dolores Redondo o Eduardo Mendoza, además de políticos, como el ministro de Cultura, Ernest Urtasun; el president de la Generalitat, Salvador Illa; el presidente del Partido Popular, Alberto Núñez Feijóo; el alcalde de Barcelona, Jaume Collboni; o el ex president Artur Mas, entre otros.

La noticia de Allende ha pillado desprevenido a más de uno. Primero por la propia presencia de la autora en Barcelona, pues ya en los últimos años admite en sus entrevistas que no está para hacer giras mundiales a sus 84 años (pese a que demostró en el estrado estar en plena forma). Segundo. porque había dado a entender que el cosmos de esa primera novela ya estaba más que amortizado. Y, por último, porque ganar este premio supone un fichaje editorial importante, pues publicaba hasta ahora en el grupo editorial contrario, Random House.
sources.headline: Isabel Allende gana el premio Planeta con la segunda parte de 'La casa de los espíritus'

stories.headline: Catalan authorities issue fresh heavy-rain warnings for Saturday

sources.body:
Protecció Civil ha activat l'alerta del pla Inuncat per la previsió de pluges intenses per a dissabte , tant a la tarda com al vespre. L'episodi es concentrarà al nord-est, la Catalunya Central i el prelitoral i el litoral centrals.

El Servei Meteorològic de Catalunya (Meteocat) ha posat en risc alt per aquest episodi nou comarques, on s'esperen pluges intenses de més de 20 litres per metre quadrat en mitja hora i de 60 litres per metre quadrat en tres hores.

De moment, els avisos comencen a les dues del migdia i duraran fins a les dues de la matinada de diumenge, quan encara es poden produir xàfecs al litoral i el prelitoral. El Meteocat alerta que els xàfecs poden anar acompanyats de tempesta i calamarsa.

En aquestes franges horàries, el grau de perill a les nou comarques és de 3 sobre 6 . En concret, l'avís taronja s'activarà a partir de les dues del migdia a Osona, el Lluçanès, el Moianès, la Selva, el Vallès Oriental i el Vallès Occidental .

A partir de les vuit del vespre , l'avís per perill alt per aquestes precipitacions es manté al Vallès Occidental i s'hi afegeixen el Barcelonès, el Baix Llobregat i el Garraf .

⚠️ El Servei Meteorològic de Catalunya emet avís de situació meteorològica de perill (#avisosSMP) per intensitat de pluja en 30 minuts⚠️ 📆 Ds. de 12 h a dg. 06:00 h. 🌧️ Possibilitat de precipitació > 20 mm / 30 minuts 🟠 Grau de perill màxim: 3/6 ⏲️ Hora local (h) = TU+2 https://t.co/ch1LNMAn9y

A partir del matí de diumenge, la previsió indica una disminució del perill. Tot i això, el Meteocat avisa que continuarà actualitzant la previsió . De fet,no es descarta que els nivells de perill augmentin en les actualitzacions d'aquest divendres.

Protecció Civil demana seguir els avisos oficials i estar atents a l'evolució de l'episodi. Així mateix, recomana consultar les prediccions i l'estat de la mobilitat abans de desplaçar-se. A més de no acostar-se a rius, rieres, barrancs, ni altres zones inundables.
sources.headline: Alerta per risc alt de pluges intenses a nou comarques a partir de dissabte a la tarda

sources.body:
El Servei Meteorològic de Catalunya acaba d’emetre la primera tongada d’avisos relacionats amb l’arribada de la dana prevista per a aquest cap de setmana. Segons adverteix l’entitat, a partir de dissabte es podrien produir pluges torrencials en bona part del territori que podrien deixar més de 60 litres per metre quadrat en períodes de només 3 hores i fins a 20 en tan sols 30 minuts. Davant aquest escenari ja s’han activat avisos grocs en una vintena de comarques catalanes del litoral i de l’interior. És possible que en futures revisions dels models es modifiquin la intensitat i el color d’aquests avisos, i també algunes de les zones potencialment afectades, però, ara per ara, tot apunta que aquest cap de setmana més de la meitat de Catalunya estarà en risc de pluges torrencials.

De moment s’han activat dos avisos preventius relacionats amb pluges torrencials. El primer, pel risc d’acumulacions de fins a 60 litres per metre quadrat en períodes de 3 hores. I el segon, per acumulacions de més de 20 litres en 30 minuts. Aquests indicadors assenyalen directament el risc de pluges molt intenses que, en alguns casos, podrien provocar inundacions locals i múltiples incidències. Ara per ara, segons indiquen els models, encara amb molta incertesa, sembla que aquest episodi, almenys a l’inici, serà menys intens que les pluges registrades a principis de mes a Catalunya i que van obligar a activar una tongada inèdita d’avisos vermells i ES-Alert a tot el territori. Tot i que caldrà veure com evoluciona el fenomen i, sobretot, fins quan s’allargarà.
sources.headline: 3 Catalunya emet una primera tanda d’avisos per pluges torrencials a partir de dissabte en una vintena de comarques del litoral i de l’interior

stories.headline: UGT demands that Barcelona's 365 café chain apply the hospitality labour agreement

sources.body: (ACN) La UGT reclama que la cadena 365 apliqui el conveni d’hostaleria als 790 treballadors que treballen en cafeteries de la demarcació de Barcelona. El sindicat ha iniciat un procediment de conciliació davant el Tribunal Laboral de Catalunya per exigir que els locals 365 deixin d’aplicar el conveni de fleques, que estableix condicions laborals “sensiblement inferiors”. També et pot interessar Barcelona supera els 300 forns amb degustació de grans cadenes, prop de quatre vegades més que fa una dècada Redacció 3 minuts de lectura Activitat pròpia d’hostaleria, segons el sindicat L’organització sindical argumenta que l’activitat que es desenvolupa és pròpia de l’hostaleria: amb taules, cadires i terrasses per consumir-hi, s’hi ofereixen begudes i s’hi venen menjars. A més, les tasques de la plantilla inclouen preparar i servir aliments, atendre la clientela i cobrar les consumicions. El sindicat recorda que tant el Conveni d’Hostaleria de Catalunya com l’acord laboral estatal d’hostaleria inclouen les cafeteries i els establiments on se serveixen menjars i begudes per consumir al mateix local. La UGT considera necessari adequar el marc laboral a l’activitat real dels establiments i “evitar que la classificació de l’empresa com a fleca serveixi per abaratir els costos laborals”. El sindicat sosté que el conveni aplicable ha de determinar-se en funció de “l’activitat preponderant que es duu a terme i no de la decisió unilateral de l’empresa”. La petició és exclusiva per als empleats de les cafeteries i no s’amplia als treballadors de l’obrador central. També et pot interessar Tercera denúncia múltiple contra forns amb degustació de Barcelona Ester Magdaleno Olga Borràs Boada 2 minuts de lectura
sources.headline: Reclamen a la cadena 365 que apliqui el conveni d’hostaleria i no el de fleques

stories.headline: Barcelona's Ateneu del Clot warns of uncertainty over its promised move to the Fàbrica del Plom

sources.body: Des del gener del 2024, l’ Ateneu del Clot manté la seu al carrer de la Muntanya, però fa anys que conviu amb la incertesa d’un emplaçament definitiu. La mobilització de veïns i socis va significar que l’Ajuntament i la propietat arribessin a un acord, in extremis , per allargar el lloguer del local i evitar que l’Ateneu desaparegués. “Al final, fruit de la mobilització , vam tenir l’alternativa d’un nou contracte en aquest espai de cinc anys, ja n’han passat quasi dos , amb el compromís del districte que començaven a fer les actuacions a la fàbrica del plom, però… cric, cric, cric, estem encara així ”, constata a l’ Infobarris Alfons Llopis, president de l’Ateneu del Clot. En aquest sentit, destaquen que no descarten tornar a mobilitzar-se perquè diuen que es troben en la mateixa situació que fa quatre anys . “Demanem informació i no ens arriba res clar, i això una altra vegada més, doncs, és esgotador ”, destaca Jordi Marzó, membre de la Junta de l’Ateneu del Clot. L’Ateneu diluït a casal de barri? Volen també més dades i terminis del projecte de rehabilitació de la Fàbrica del Plom , al carrer de la Verneda, una zona que està pendent d’una aprovació imminent del Pla de millora urbana. L’espai és de titularitat municipal des del 2022 , quan el consistori la va expropiar, cinc anys després que la cooperativa Biciclot deixés de fer-hi la seva activitat de foment de l’ús de la bicicleta. També et pot interessar Biciclot estrena una nova sèrie de bicicletes reciclades Àlex Jassé Javier Arilla 1 minut de lectura Per molta informació que nosaltres demanem “l’Ajuntament tampoc no ens explica molt bé quin serà el model de gestió ni si podrem mantenir les activitats de dinamització que fem al barri”, continua explicant Marzó. Des de L ‘Ajuntament s’assegura que el projecte segueix el seu curs , i que un cop aprovat, se’n podran facilitar més detalls. La previsió és que les obres es licitin durant el proper mandat. Llopis, per la seva banda, assegura que es fa una pregunta: “Com funcionarà un casal de barri i un Ateneu al mateix lloc, si són dues organitzacions que fan el mateix?” I afegeix que temen que la feina de l’Ateneu es dilueixi i acabi convertit en el casal de barri , que l’Ajuntament preveu fer-hi a la Fàbrica del Plom. També lamenten que, com anys enrere, no saben quan hauran de marxar de l’espai actual, tampoc quan començaran les obres a la fàbrica, però alerten “el que sí que sabem és que s’acabarà el contracte i no estarà acabada la reforma de la Fàbrica del Plom i ja hi tornarem a ser”. També et pot interessar Perilla la continuïtat de l’Ateneu del Clot per manca de local Àngels Molina Anna Feliu 3 minuts de lectura
sources.headline: Incertesa a l’Ateneu del Clot pel futur trasllat a la Fàbrica del Plom
